changes: Extract source entry markup; cloud adapter owns lifecycle, canonical preview and workspace commands.
Reuse current quantity serialization and opaque portion identifiers.
Keep unknown energy unavailable instead of source zero fallback.
Use SVG section arrows without font dependency.
Adapt source dialog selectors to cloud sheet; restore Edit a copy with server-owned source resolution and a shared custom-food editor.

contract.mountFoodEntry: Returns disposer function. Invokes show(html) once; adds #sheet.mf-detail. Caller disposes before replacing or closing sheet.
contract.onChange: Async refresh called after favorite or entry mutation.
contract.onAdjust: Open occurrence ingredient adjustment for current recipe/meal.
contract.onConflict: Reload latest entry on command conflict.
contract.draft/onApply: Draft quantity/date/group/time seed the editor. Apply returns values without a diary command; Back discards the edit.
contract.onCopy/viewState: Food-only Edit a copy calls onCopy with raw input, section and scroll state. Remount with viewState to restore unchanged entry/search context.
